Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the secretary of transportation to realign the transportation regions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the realignment of transportation regions; andadding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By July 1, 2011, as a means of reducing department administrativecosts and providing more efficient use of department resources, thesecretary shall realign the transportation regions to include: (1) The Olympic region, containing Clallam, Jefferson, GraysHarbor, Mason, Pacific, Lewis, Wahkiakum, Cowlitz, Clark, Skamania, andKitsap counties and the portion of Thurston county west of Interstate5; (2) The northwest region, containing San Juan, Island, Whatcom, andSkagit counties and the portion of Snohomish county that includes andis north of Smokey Point; (3) The Puget Sound region, containing King and Pierce counties and(a) the portion of Thurston county that includes and is east ofInterstate 5 and (b) the portion of Snohomish county that is south ofSmokey Point; p. 1 SB 5682 (4) The central region, containing Okanogan, Chelan, Douglas,Grant, Kittitas, Yakima, and Klickitat counties; and (5) The eastern region, containing Ferry, Stevens, Pend Oreille,Lincoln, Spokane, Adams, Whitman, Franklin, Benton, Walla Walla,Columbia, Garfield, and Asotin counties.
